name: Job Finder — Step 2: Search Jobs (Apify + Firecrawl)

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives the profile JSON from the frontend (output of Analyze Resume workflow).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ queries: [$json.primaryKeyword + ' ' + $json.skillSuffix + ' jobs'], locationName: $json.primaryLocation + ', India', rows: 10, contractType: 'F', publishedAt: 'r604800' }) }}

nodes.name: Apify: LinkedIn Jobs
nodes.notes: Uses Apify actor apify/linkedin-jobs-scraper. Set APIFY_TOKEN in N8N Settings → Variables. run-sync-get-dataset-items waits for completion and returns results directly.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ url: $json.naukriUrl, formats: ['extract'], extract: { prompt: 'Extract all job listings from this Naukri.com page. For each job return: title (job title), company (company name), location (city), salary (salary range if shown), description (first 200 chars of job description), url (full URL to job posting). Return as JSON array under key "jobs".', schema: { type: 'object', properties: { jobs: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: { title: {type:'string'}, company: {type:'string'}, location: {type:'string'}, salary: {type:'string'}, description: {type:'string'}, url: {type:'string'} } } } }, required: ['jobs'] } } }) }}

nodes.name: Firecrawl: Naukri
nodes.notes: Firecrawl scrapes Naukri search results page and uses AI extraction to pull structured job data. Set FIRECRAWL_KEY in N8N Settings → Variables.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ url: $json.glassdoorSearchUrl, formats: ['extract'], extract: { prompt: 'Extract all job listings from this Glassdoor jobs page. For each job return: title (job title), company (company name), location (city), salary (salary range if shown), description (first 200 chars of description), url (full URL to job posting on glassdoor.co.in). Return as JSON array under key "jobs".', schema: { type: 'object', properties: { jobs: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: { title: {type:'string'}, company: {type:'string'}, location: {type:'string'}, salary: {type:'string'}, description: {type:'string'}, url: {type:'string'} } } } }, required: ['jobs'] } } }) }}

nodes.name: Firecrawl: Glassdoor
nodes.notes: Firecrawl scrapes Glassdoor search results and extracts structured job data.
